frame_store.description: A stream's recent frames, delivered together at the pace their consumer takes them. Every frame that comes in is kept, in a ring of SLOTS, and the consumer is handed the newest FRAMES whole ones side by side -- channel k the frame k before the newest -- as often as it asks, each with the context of the newest and the size its beats draw. The input never waits for the output: a consumer slower than the source repeats frames of frames, a faster one skips some, neither tears one. A source that reaches a slot being read is never stopped, and `overrun` says so.

BITS.description: One sample of the stream in.

FRAMES.description: Frames delivered together: how far back the consumer reads.

SLOTS.description: Frames kept, FRAMES and the slack: the frames a source may begin, past the newest whole one, while a frame of frames is read.

CTX_BITS.description: The stream's context, its CTX member: carried whole with each frame, never read.

PIXELS.description: The largest frame kept, in samples.

BASE.description: Where the first slot starts in external memory, the slots a frame's samples apart rounded up to 4K: a region the design keeps for the store alone.

inputs.name: rst
inputs.description: Active high: the stream's, starting the store over whenever its stream starts over.

inputs.name: mem_rst
inputs.description: Active high: the memory's, the one reset of the master on it -- a master reset alone mid-burst leaves its memory waiting.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: The frames, as their source sends them: each frame's size the one its beats draw, its context taken with its first beat.

outputs.name: out
outputs.description: The newest FRAMES frames side by side, newest in the low bits, of the newest's size and with its context.

outputs.name: out_source
outputs.description: Which input frame the frames out are computed at, counted from reset: a repeat shows as the same number.

outputs.name: cold
outputs.description: Fewer than FRAMES frames of one history are whole: nothing goes out.

outputs.name: overrun
outputs.description: Sticky until reset: the source reached a frame being read.

outputs.name: mem
outputs.description: The external memory the frames live in: bursts of sixteen beats at most, one ID, every burst inside one 4K page.

bram.description: The frames in block RAM, one memory a slot, PIXELS samples deep.

axi.description: The frames in external memory over AXI4, from BASE: a frame is whole once its writes are answered, and each frame read is fetched ahead into a queue of its own.
